key_impacts: Overwhelming quantities of debris were left by the earthquake.
Some buildings, though still standing, were rendered uninhabitable and required safe demolition to prevent danger to the community.
Private and government structures were terminally damaged, necessitating demolition and rubble clearance.
Public and private buildings sustained damage that required structural assessment.

key_impacts: A 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck the Pacific Coast of Ecuador on 16 April 2016.
UNV established an Ecuador Earthquake Taskforce and deployed 50 UN Volunteers as frontline responders.
Volunteer assignments included monitoring and evaluation of shelters, training and mentoring of women, communications, architecture, health and reporting.
